descriptive_development_only.interpretation: The frozen 10-bps-per-cash-sleeve-change primary implementation charged cumulative sweep friction larger than its 50%-realized carry and failed primary economics. Descriptively, passive no-extra-sweep-cost carry remained positive across the frozen yield-realization row, motivating only a separately governed new-ID implementation-mechanism study.

scientific_interpretation: 0063 rejects the prospectively frozen implementation that combines 50% DTB3 realization with an additional 10 bps cost on every L1 change in the idle-cash sleeve.
This does not reject cash carry in general; the study was designed to separate carry from an explicit transaction-like sweep-friction model.
The zero-sweep and lower-friction cells are exposed post-result diagnostics only. They cannot rescue 0063, alter its classification, or be selected as same-ID winners.
Any study of passive interest-bearing cash, custody spread, money-market fee or another cost model requires a new research ID with prospectively frozen economics and robustness gates.
same_id_forbidden_followup: change primary sweep friction from 10 bps after seeing the result
change yield realization from the frozen 50% primary after seeing the result
drop G2, G3, G4, G5 or G6
redefine sweep turnover or charge timing
new_id_followup_allowed: A separately governed result-informed DEVELOPMENT study may test passive interest-bearing idle cash with a continuous annual spread/fee rather than transaction-like sweep friction.
The new-ID study must freeze its primary cost model before outcome computation and cannot treat 0063 zero-sweep cells as independent validation.
Independent confirmation still requires future-only validation after any DEVELOPMENT pass.
